test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. He used to commit one theft a year on average. The stolen money lasted for the year.

B. He chose the house at Shotover Grange to commit his next burglary. He studied the design of the house carefully for a fortnight.

C. He found that the family had gone to London and the servants to the movie. He broke into the house one afternoon.

D. He hoped to get fifteen thousand pounds worth of jewels from the safe.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1) **i.e.** "ABCD."****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence A** introduces the character's annual theft habit.
 
• **Sentence B** details the planning for the next theft.
 
• **Sentence C** describes the act of burglary.
 
• **Sentence D** reveals the objective of the theft.

The correct answer is "A-B-C-D."

Complete passage: ***He used to commit one theft a year on average. The stolen money lasted for the year. He chose the house at Shotover Grange to commit his next burglary. He studied the design of the house carefully for a fortnight. He found that the family had gone to London and the servants to the movie. He broke into the house one afternoon. He hoped to get fifteen thousand pounds worth of jewels from the safe.*
